description: This file defines the 'EmploymentStatus' entity class for the OrangeHRM project, using Doctrine ORM annotations to map the class to the 'ohrm_employment_status' database table. The class includes properties for 'id', 'name', and a collection of associated employees, with corresponding getter and setter methods.
